letter.text: I wake up with a letter in my hand.
The handwriting is mine. I don't remember writing it.

Trust Dov.
You won't remember why.

At the Records Office I saw the Ledger. Next: Dov's name.
Written before nightfall. — R.
The ink is still wet. Whoever Dov is, I lost him only hours ago.

meet_dov.text: Morning. The rain hasn't stopped since the Hush.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Rhea! Thank the lanterns. You're all right.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: Do I know you?

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: It's me. Dov. Your brother.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: I don't have a brother.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: You did, until last night.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: That's what every liar in Veyra says to a courier.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Look at the letter in your hand. I watched you write it.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: Anyone can slip a note into a sleeping courier's fist.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Yesterday you came home white as paper. You said my name was next in the Ledger.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: We tried to reach the Records Office. Hollows pinned us in the alleys until midnight.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Then you looked at me, and asked who I was.
A calico cat darts out of the alley, past Rhea, and leaps into the stranger's arms.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Nala. Hey, girl. You still know me, don't you?

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: She's never let anyone hold her. Not even me.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Animals don't live in the Reliquary. The King can't take me from her.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: ...The letter said to trust you. Fine. I'll trust the cat.
Grey raincoats in the fog. Smooth faces, no eyes. Blanks.
Behind them, grey dust gathers into something with claws. Nala hisses at it.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: That one is made of me. Everything you knew about me, until last night.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: Then I'm taking it back.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: When it broke, something came loose and stuck to me. Not a face. A feeling.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: That's what Hollows are. What the King took, given claws.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Break one, and the pieces drift free. Sometimes they find their way home.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: If everyone forgot you, why are you still here?

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: The Forgotten don't die. We just stop belonging to anyone.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: I spent the night working out that I still belong to you. Even if you don't know it.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: And your Echo? What do you burn?

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Your technique comes from your heaviest memory. Mine is you, small, on my shoulders.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: The lantern festival. That's what Anchor is.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: That's fine. I remember it for both of us.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: The Ledger lists who goes next. Your name was on it.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Then we take it tonight, before it takes anyone else.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: ...So nobody else wakes up a stranger to their own family.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: The Records Office, then. Nala, stay close.
Halfway there, Nala's fur stands on end. More of him, in the dust.

records_office.text: The Records Office. Shelves to the ceiling, every drawer full of names.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: A courier. Again. You were here yesterday, weren't you?

records_office.speaker: Rhea
records_office.text: I don't remember. You'd know why.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: I was the royal archivist. Twenty-seven years ago, the council handed me a king's name.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: I struck it from every page in Veyra. I watched his statues fall. I was proud of my books.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: The King came back. The first name he unwrote was mine.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: He put a pen in my hand. "Fill the Ledger, and I will give you your name back."

records_office.speaker: Rhea
records_office.text: The Reliquary promised that no one would be forgotten. And you believe him?

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: It is the only promise I have left.

records_office.speaker: Dov
records_office.text: Give us the book, and no one else has to go through this.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: And who are you? ...Ah. No one. Filed and forgotten. I wrote that entry last night.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Rhea
keepsake_burn.text: I can't beat him like this. I need more Echo.
A Keepsake: a memory held back for the end. Seven years of burning left Rhea only one.
Today. A stranger in the rain. A cat running to him. His voice saying her name.
What you burn, you never get back.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Dov
keepsake_burn.text: Rhea, don't. That's the only part of me you have left.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Rhea
keepsake_burn.text: Then remember it for both of us.
She burns it. Her Echo floods back.

ending.speaker: The Clerk
ending.text: No... I was so close. They were going to remember me...

ending.speaker: Rhea
ending.text: The King promised a whole city that, too.
The Ledger falls open. Tonight's page is blank.

ending.speaker: Dov
ending.text: For one night, nobody in Veyra is taken.

ending.speaker: Rhea
ending.text: We did it. We have the Ledger.
She turns to the man beside her. Tall, worn jacket, bandaged fists.
A calico cat winds between his legs, then looks up at Rhea.
Rhea's hand finds a folded letter in her coat. Her own handwriting.

Trust Dov.
You won't remember why.

ending.speaker: Rhea
ending.text: Then I trust you. I don't know why.
Above the city, on the empty plinth of a fallen king, a silhouette watches.
